analyst_view.overall: Early view: two lower-mid-table sides a point apart. Alavés steadied with a 0-0 at Sevilla after a 6-1 loss at Barcelona, with Sivera saving a penalty, but have not won in five league games and have Garcés and Mikel Rodríguez out with knee ligament injuries; Eder Sarabia's Espanyol are possession-heavy but low-scoring, and play Getafe on the Monday before this.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals. Alavés drew 0-0 at Sevilla and 1-1 with Málaga, and Espanyol have two goals in their last three games with Kike García out until December. I lean slightly lower, around 2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Alavés took 7 corners at home against Málaga and Espanyol's games have produced 10-14 recently; Sarabia's side will keep the ball, which should push Alavés back at times. I stay around 9-10.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. Espanyol have collected three to five yellows in each of their last three games and Alavés had three at both Sevilla and Barcelona, so a scrappy game between close rivals points a little higher, around 6.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots. Espanyol have been cautious away (5 shots at Villarreal, 11 at Racing) while Alavés's games at Sevilla and Barcelona had 22 and 20 shots in total. I lean lower, around 22.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 on target. Neither attack is sharp: Alavés scored once from 18 shots against Málaga, and Espanyol rely on set pieces and headers without Kike García. I lean lower, around 7.
